chapter: Trumpet players of the old days
title: Gabriel's six musical sons
summary: Gabriel names his sons and what each plays.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Rudolph played the drum, but Dave played the clarinet. And those other boys, all those boys, as Moran's played music. It's like I have six boys. I have Joe, he plays bass. I have my little boy, he plays the piano and the organ. Elliot, he's been the line half for three years. I have Charles, he's played the sax, the clarinet, the flute, the baritone. I have the next one, August, he plays the trumpet, he plays the organ. I have Morton, he plays the piano and the trumpet. That's only five, short of one of them, I don't know which one. I think that's about six of them. Well, they all play. Leonard, he plays the trumpet too. It's a pretty valid tritomo, but he plays. He's young, but I mean, he plays all of them, and all of them play.
